description: Fix Play Together: Zero skips, zero mid-song jumps, synchronized queues, and smooth party playback.
changelog: Fixed Play Together songs skipping rapidly & infinite skip loops
Fixed mid-song forward jumps by removing 10s heartbeat hard seeks and introducing smooth speed micro-adjustments
Fixed guest playback stall by ensuring ExoPlayer prepare() and playWhenReady are immediately called
Fixed host and guest playing different songs by binding synchronized queues and isolating guest controls
Disabled Automix and Silence Skip during party sessions to eliminate artificial clock drift
